'''2000 DecipherCon Team Event''' was a Star Wars CCG team event held in Kissimmee, Florida on 8 October 2000. [[Team Albany]] won it. It is known from Arthur Rhodes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1313">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-09-arts-team-tourny-reportd1313/ arts-team-tourny-report], DeckTech (Arthur "arthur" Rhodes, 9 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-09-arts-team-tourny-reportd1313/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 8 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Team Albany]]
